findings.summary: Requirement R1 (Ingestion) is scheduled for delivery in Milestone M3, which falls outside the audited range (M1-M2) expected by the sample check.

evidence.note: Requirement R1 mandates recursive discovery of Markdown files from an input directory.
evidence.quote: The system MUST accept a user-specified local directory path as input and recursively discover Markdown files...

evidence.note: Milestone M3 explicitly lists the delivery of the Ingestion Plugin to satisfy R1, contradicting the expectation of R1 availability in M1/M2.
evidence.quote: Ingestion Plugin (C11) + CLI wiring to satisfy directory input/discovery (R1) and build workflow (R5).

findings.summary: Requirement R3 (Markdown Rendering) is scheduled for delivery in Milestone M3, which falls outside the audited range (M1-M2) expected by the sample check.

evidence.note: Requirement R3 mandates CommonMark-compliant parsing and HTML generation.
evidence.quote: The system MUST parse each discovered Markdown file using at least CommonMark-compliant syntax...

evidence.note: Milestone M3 explicitly lists the delivery of the Markdown Render Plugin to satisfy R3, contradicting the expectation of R3 availability in M1/M2.
evidence.quote: Markdown Render Plugin (C14) implementing CommonMark baseline rendering (R3, R4)...

findings.summary: Deterministic sample check for R1 links milestones [M1, M2], but the plan’s milestone deliverables place R1 implementation (ingestion + CLI wiring) in M3 (DL7); M1–M2 are contract/scaffold and do not explicitly deliver R1.

evidence.note: Sample check claims R1 is covered by milestones M1 and M2.
M3 deliverable DL7 explicitly targets R1/R5 via ingestion plugin + CLI wiring.
evidence.quote: Ingestion Plugin (C11) + CLI wiring to satisfy directory input/discovery (R1) and build workflow (R5).

findings.summary: Deterministic sample check for R3 links milestones [M1, M2], but the plan’s milestone deliverables place CommonMark parsing/rendering (R3/R4) in M3 (DL8); M1–M2 do not explicitly deliver R3.

evidence.note: Sample check claims R3 is covered by milestones M1 and M2.
M3 deliverable DL8 explicitly targets R3/R4 via Markdown render plugin (CommonMark baseline).
evidence.quote: Markdown Render Plugin (C14) implementing CommonMark baseline rendering (R3, R4) and producing per-note HTML fragments into the context.
